enemies.name: Rootling
enemies.silhouette_and_role: Small walking knot of roots; quick skirmisher
enemies.skills_and_telegraphs: `Root Prick`: warns one adjacent tile, low damage + Root 0.7s; `Creep`: shifts one safe tile sideways after 1.2s
enemies.counterplay: Don't stand still; hit before second windup

enemies.name: Mossbound Sentry
enemies.silhouette_and_role: Short stone sentry with moss shoulder
enemies.skills_and_telegraphs: `Slab Tap`: warns 2-cell bar; `Brace`: guard on own occupied tile after a visible crouch
enemies.counterplay: Move perpendicular to bar; flank with L Block

enemies.name: Greycap Sporeling
enemies.silhouette_and_role: Dull purple-gray mushroom cluster
enemies.skills_and_telegraphs: `Spore Squares`: warns 3-cell L, mild Poison; `Seedbed`: sets one dark green temporary hazard tile
enemies.counterplay: Avoid clustered corners; clear marked source early

enemies.name: Ancient Root Sentinel
enemies.silhouette_and_role: Long trunk, blocky crown; roots link two distant floor tiles
enemies.skills_and_telegraphs: `Branch Net`: warns a line of 3 and Roots only if the first tile hits; `Bark Shift`: creates one temporary non-pit barrier
enemies.counterplay: Break its amber-tipped root anchor with a 2+ tile Block before follow-up; rewards Guard/Root relic

enemies.name: Mistbriar Matron
enemies.silhouette_and_role: Hooded bark effigy with a dangling dry-vine arm
enemies.skills_and_telegraphs: `Thorn Fork`: one warned tile branches into two orthogonal cells on next beat; `Wreath Guard`: guards at 50% HP
enemies.counterplay: Track first tile then exit branch; shatter anchor, rewards delayed-chain artifact

enemies.name: Chain Rat
enemies.silhouette_and_role: Low crawling rodent dragging square chain-link
enemies.skills_and_telegraphs: `Snag`: 1-cell warning, mild slow; `Chain Skip`: appears at an adjacent valid tile after telling blink
enemies.counterplay: Move diagonally once; avoid putting both feet next to pit

enemies.name: Stonebound Prisoner
enemies.silhouette_and_role: Bent revenant with slab arms
enemies.skills_and_telegraphs: `Cell Slam`: 2-cell vertical line, high delayed damage; `Shale Guard`: one-hit barrier
enemies.counterplay: Move one column; shatter guard with single-hit setup

enemies.name: Gaol Bell
enemies.silhouette_and_role: Suspended iron-cage mimic, logical one-tile enemy
enemies.skills_and_telegraphs: `Clang`: cross-shaped telegraph around itself (clipped to arena), stagger; `Echo Ring`: repeats 1-center tile 1 beat later
enemies.counterplay: Leave center immediately, return only after second beat

enemies.name: Chain Jailer
enemies.silhouette_and_role: Tall plated jailor, chain winding around arm
enemies.skills_and_telegraphs: `Lockstep`: temporarily blocks one adjacent tile before 3-cell bar strike; `Dragback`: pulls actor one safe square if struck
enemies.counterplay: Break the chain anchor or escape along perpendicular row; reward displacement/guard artifacts

enemies.name: Gatebreaker Golem
enemies.silhouette_and_role: Broad torso, one huge stone fist
enemies.skills_and_telegraphs: `Broken Gate`: warns 2×2 then cracks one non-occupied slab into a future pit (after additional warning); `Crush Line`: a slow 3-cell bar
enemies.counterplay: Move off cracking slab in advance; exploit long recovery; reward pit-control relic

enemies.name: Frost Wisp
enemies.silhouette_and_role: One square-faced pale mist spirit
enemies.skills_and_telegraphs: `Cold Point`: 1 tile, slow for 1 cast; `Glide`: shift to neighboring safe tile
enemies.counterplay: Target its destination; avoid stacking slow

enemies.name: Rime Gargoyle
enemies.silhouette_and_role: Icicle-edged slab knight
enemies.skills_and_telegraphs: `Ice Fang`: short 3-cell L, applies Freeze if already slowed; `Stone Skin`: 1 hit armor
enemies.counterplay: Clear Slow first, choose safe corner of L

enemies.name: Snowglass Crow
enemies.silhouette_and_role: Small bird with angular icy wings
enemies.skills_and_telegraphs: `Perch Mark`: marks 2 separated cells; `Drop Frost`: strikes those two after fixed delay
enemies.counterplay: Move after second warning; hit during perched recovery

enemies.name: Broken Ice Knight
enemies.silhouette_and_role: Split blue-silver helm, tall spear-shaped gauntlet
enemies.skills_and_telegraphs: `Mirror Freeze`: telegraphs one column and the adjacent column next beat; `Ice Guard`: freezes after taking a Block hit when armored
enemies.counterplay: Use short Block to bait armor, then move to already resolved column; reward freeze/shatter artifact

enemies.name: Bell of White Mist
enemies.silhouette_and_role: Silent bell golem with floating ice shards (no glow)
enemies.skills_and_telegraphs: `Hush`: delays hero's next Skill Card activation; `Ice Clock`: warns 3 successive single tiles
enemies.counterplay: Observe timing; save quick block/guard for delay window; reward charge/cooldown relic

enemies.name: Muck Leech
enemies.silhouette_and_role: Low pale-gray leech with square jaw
enemies.skills_and_telegraphs: `Siphon`: warns 1 tile, drains tiny amount of HP/guard; `Crawl`: moves to near safe tile
enemies.counterplay: Strike before close approach; don't stack drain

enemies.name: Sporecap Drifter
enemies.silhouette_and_role: Thin mushroom stalk with dull lilac cap
enemies.skills_and_telegraphs: `Spores`: 3-cell L, applies 1 Poison; `Bloom`: leaves a 1-tile hazard for 2 beats
enemies.counterplay: Avoid same hazard repeatedly; safe route outside L

enemies.name: Bog Toadlet
enemies.silhouette_and_role: Tiny squat toad, broad head
enemies.skills_and_telegraphs: `Mud Belly`: 2 adjacent cells, pushes one safe tile; `Croak Windup`: signals next 1-cell poison slap
enemies.counterplay: Stay away from pit/border, avoid push

enemies.name: Mycelium Abbess
enemies.silhouette_and_role: Tall mushroom-veiled swamp matron
enemies.skills_and_telegraphs: `Bloom Web`: connects two poisoned tiles; strike repeats if player stands on either 1 beat later; `Spore Veil`: guard until one hazard destroyed
enemies.counterplay: Destroy one spore anchor with a Block, then dodge followup; reward Poison-proc relic

enemies.name: Bog Resin Harvester
enemies.silhouette_and_role: Hunched collector with square pitch bucket
enemies.skills_and_telegraphs: `Sticky Patch`: changes 2 tiles to slowing mud; `Resin Press`: warns T-shape and adds Fragile
enemies.counterplay: Leave slow mud immediately, avoid T center; reward field-control relic

enemies.name: Dune Scarab
enemies.silhouette_and_role: Angular low beetle, dusty carapace
enemies.skills_and_telegraphs: `Sand Nip`: 1-cell mark then hit; `Burrow Shift`: moves to an *announced* adjacent tile
enemies.counterplay: Follow emergence shadow, not motion blur

enemies.name: Buried Sentinel
enemies.silhouette_and_role: Cracked standing statue, flat square face
enemies.skills_and_telegraphs: `Column Stamp`: entire valid column after slow windup; `Sand Guard`: one-use barrier
enemies.counterplay: Move across a column, guard against forced trap

enemies.name: Dustshade
enemies.silhouette_and_role: Hooded sand shade with frayed hem
enemies.skills_and_telegraphs: `False Step`: previews 2 candidate cells, one becomes active red warning in time to dodge; `Sift`: switches its own tile
enemies.counterplay: Only dodge on final red warning; never give fake-red warnings

enemies.name: Lesser Sand Sphinx
enemies.silhouette_and_role: Miniature lion-stone beast with cracked mask
enemies.skills_and_telegraphs: `Riddle Steps`: 3 sequential 1-tile strikes travel left-to-right; `Stone Wing`: guards while standing on marked central tile
enemies.counterplay: Predict sweep, break guard with side approach; reward sequential-hit relic

enemies.name: Hourglass Custodian
enemies.silhouette_and_role: Stone gaoler with sand-filled square vessel
enemies.skills_and_telegraphs: `Time Debt`: marks tile now, repeats the same target 2 beats later; `Delay Snare`: slows card activation
enemies.counterplay: Watch repeating mark, hold dodge/guard; reward time/echo modifier

enemies.name: Ash Walker
enemies.silhouette_and_role: Compact gray humanoid with a dim amber chest fissure
enemies.skills_and_telegraphs: `Cinder Press`: warns one tile then deals Burn; `Ash Drift`: hops to pre-marked safe tile
enemies.counterplay: Target landing point, don't stay on heated square

enemies.name: Ember Imp
enemies.silhouette_and_role: Small horned dark sprite, no flame aura
enemies.skills_and_telegraphs: `Crack Line`: warns 2-cell bar, Burn 1; `Coal Leap`: moves one tile if threatened
enemies.counterplay: Side-step perpendicular to line

enemies.name: Furnace Chainling
enemies.silhouette_and_role: Chain link animated around a compact core
enemies.skills_and_telegraphs: `Link Tap`: warns one cell, Fragile; `Chain Heat`: next 2 cells in row warned after first resolves
enemies.counterplay: Watch chain propagation, exit row

enemies.name: Cinder Magistrate
enemies.silhouette_and_role: Crowned charcoal statue with long angular gauntlet
enemies.skills_and_telegraphs: `Sentence`: 3-tile line with delayed second stamp; `Hot Verdict`: tiles previously hit in fight get marked for repeat
enemies.counterplay: Track recent marks; break its square armor during recovery; reward burn/echo relic

enemies.name: Coal Colossus
enemies.silhouette_and_role: Enormous squared shoulders, molten seams, logical 1 tile
enemies.skills_and_telegraphs: `Crucible`: 2×2 warned area, one of those tiles cracks and becomes a pit *after another warning*; `Fist Stamp`: 3-cell T
enemies.counterplay: Respect gap and safe route; punish long recovery; reward terrain-change relic

enemies.name: Cloud Hatchling
enemies.silhouette_and_role: Small horned drake, muted gray scales
enemies.skills_and_telegraphs: `Sky Stamp`: 2-cell line, shock slow; `Wing Shuffle`: steps to announced neighboring tile
enemies.counterplay: Move perpendicular, anticipate landing

enemies.name: Floating Slabling
enemies.silhouette_and_role: Small levitating chunk of plain stone
enemies.skills_and_telegraphs: `Loose Edge`: warns a tile that becomes unavailable for 1 beat; `Stone Press`: a 1-cell hit after wait
enemies.counterplay: Keep one escape tile, plan beyond edge

enemies.name: Gale Feather
enemies.silhouette_and_role: Birdlike wind sprite with stiff square feathers
enemies.skills_and_telegraphs: `Gust Fork`: 3-cell L, pushes one valid tile; `Perch`: holds position for one beat
enemies.counterplay: Avoid pushes toward pits, use root/guard

enemies.name: Thunderbound Knight
enemies.silhouette_and_role: Broad stone mail, muted brass bolt crest
enemies.skills_and_telegraphs: `Bridge Claim`: warns bridge row, blocks one edge square for 1 beat; `Three-Step Thunder`: 3 distinct single strikes at increasing tempo
enemies.counterplay: Exit claimed line early; reward mobility/charge relic

enemies.name: Bridge Keeper
enemies.silhouette_and_role: Long-limbed stone golem gripping floating slab, logical 1 tile
enemies.skills_and_telegraphs: `Missing Span`: removes 1 announced non-occupied tile for 2 beats; `Bridge Rebuild`: restores one tile and strikes a different warned tile
enemies.counterplay: Pathfind with pit-safe tiles; reward restore/terrain relic

enemies.name: Lattice Sentinel
enemies.silhouette_and_role: Ivory square-stone guardian, small segmented crest
enemies.skills_and_telegraphs: `Pattern Copy`: repeats opponent's last 2-cell target shape, red-warned; `Stillguard`: guard after one resolved hit
enemies.counterplay: Change tile after own cast, break guard using two-phase skill

enemies.name: Broken Echo
enemies.silhouette_and_role: Jagged gray tile apparition, chipped shoulders
enemies.skills_and_telegraphs: `Echo Stamp`: 1 tile now + same tile after beat; `Fragment Move`: shifts one safe tile
enemies.counterplay: Remember previous impact, punish echo cooldown

enemies.name: Mirror-Slab Keeper
enemies.silhouette_and_role: Split mirrored mask on pale stone
enemies.skills_and_telegraphs: `Reflection`: next marked pattern reappears rotated 90 degrees (final warning shown), `Fracture`: 2×2 damage
enemies.counterplay: Watch displayed final rotation, never trust only initial shape; reward rotation artifact

enemies.name: Primal Archive Construct
enemies.silhouette_and_role: Rigid robe of square stone slabs, bright gold shard overhead
enemies.skills_and_telegraphs: `Memory Line`: recalls last two warned lines, one after the other; `Seal`: disables repeated card for one beat
enemies.counterplay: Use different Skill Card and rotate off recalled lines; reward artifact + Heart Shard fragment
